item.title: Wrist reminders through the iPhone app
item.summary: Request a wrist reminder now or schedule one through Murph after connecting a compatible band in Wrist reminders.
item.details: The experimental connection supports WHOOP 5/MG and Garmin Find Device commands. Keep Murph open with the band connected when the reminder is due. Garmin may also make a sound; device compatibility is still being verified.
